title: HB2484 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, removes criminal liability for possession on posted premises for a permit holder who immediately leaves posted premises upon being asked to do so. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1359.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2018-02-01; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1714285)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2018-02-01 (twin SB 2336). Replaces TCA 39-17-1359(c)(1). Summary says 'As introduced'; no enactment shown; adopted amendments, if any, are not in the text read. Effective July 1, 2018.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1359(c)(1)): (1) It is an offense to possess a weapon in a building or on property that is properly posted in accordance with this section; provided, that it is not an offense under this section if the person possessing a weapon is a permit holder pursuant to § 39-17- 1351 who immediately leaves the premises upon being asked to do so.
